CBI chargesheets ex-judge and son in Twisha Sharma death case

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has filed a chargesheet against former judge Giribala Singh and her son in connection with the death of Twisha Sharma. The chargesheet alleges cruelty and dowry death. However, an AIIMS medical board, following a court-ordered second postmortem, concluded that Twisha Sharma's death was by suicide by hanging and found no signs of assault or struggle on her body. The CBI's chargesheet reportedly details Twisha Sharma's final days, including claims of sustained psychological harm and a final message stating, 'Let me die in peace.'
